name: Funerary Urn (Hunping)
material: green-glazed stoneware with molded and sculpted decoration
dimensions: Diameter: 28.8 cm (11 5/16 in.); Overall: 52.1 cm (20 1/2 in.)
summary: Green-glazed stoneware developed greater variety in the south after the Han dynasty. Large funerary urns known as hunping, or "the urn of the soul," are evidence for its prolific production.
